# THA Authorization Guide

CPT codes, ICD-10 codes, payer requirements, and documentation checklist for Total Hip Arthroplasty (THA)

Tabs: CPT Codes | ICD-10 | Payer Requirements | Documentation | Submission | Denial Reasons

## CPT Codes

- **27130** — Total hip arthroplasty (primary) — RVU: 22.18 — Includes femoral and acetabular components
- **27132** — Conversion of previous hip surgery to total hip arthroplasty — RVU: 24.50 — Conversion from prior ORIF, hemiarthroplasty, or resurfacing
- **27134** — Revision total hip arthroplasty — both components — RVU: 30.20 — Full revision — acetabular and femoral components
- **27137** — Revision total hip arthroplasty — acetabular component only — RVU: 24.10 — Isolated acetabular revision
- **27138** — Revision total hip arthroplasty — femoral component only — RVU: 22.80 — Isolated femoral revision

## ICD-10 Codes

- **M16.11** — Unilateral primary osteoarthritis, right hip — Most common indication
- **M16.12** — Unilateral primary osteoarthritis, left hip — Most common indication
- **M16.0** — Bilateral primary osteoarthritis of hip — Bilateral disease
- **M16.31** — Unilateral post-traumatic osteoarthritis, right hip — Post-traumatic OA
- **M16.32** — Unilateral post-traumatic osteoarthritis, left hip — Post-traumatic OA
- **M87.051** — Idiopathic aseptic necrosis of bone, right femur — AVN indication
- **M87.052** — Idiopathic aseptic necrosis of bone, left femur — AVN indication
- **M16.21** — Unilateral osteoarthritis resulting from hip dysplasia, right hip — Dysplasia-related OA
- **M05.751** — Rheumatoid arthritis with rheumatoid factor, right hip — RA indication

## Payer Requirements

### Medicare — Prior Auth Required

**Medical Necessity Criteria:**
- Documented hip OA or AVN with radiographic evidence
- Failure of ≥3 months conservative therapy (PT, NSAIDs, assistive devices)
- Functional impairment documented (Harris Hip Score, HOOS, or VAS)
- BMI <40 preferred; BMI 40-50 requires additional documentation
- No active infection or absolute contraindications
- Prior auth required for most Medicare Advantage plans

**Reimbursement:** Medicare pays ~$1,400-2,200 surgeon fee; facility fee varies. CJR bundled payment model may apply.

**Known Payer Policies:**
| Payer | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Medicare FFS | Covered | No prior auth for traditional Medicare; required for most MA plans |
| Medicare Advantage (UHC) | Prior Auth Required | eviCore criteria; clinical notes and imaging required |
| Medicare Advantage (Humana) | Prior Auth Required | Peer-to-peer available if denied |

### Medicaid — Prior Auth Required

**Medical Necessity Criteria:**
- State-specific criteria; most require documented OA with radiographic evidence
- Conservative therapy failure (typically ≥6 months)
- Age ≥18; some states restrict for patients <50
- Prior authorization universally required

**Reimbursement:** Medicaid reimbursement typically 40-60% of Medicare rates.

**Known Payer Policies:**
| Payer | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Medicaid MCO | Prior Auth Required | Criteria vary by state; conservative therapy documentation critical |

### Private Insurance — Prior Auth Required

**Medical Necessity Criteria:**
- Radiographic evidence of hip OA or AVN
- Documented failure of ≥3-6 months conservative treatment
- Functional assessment scores (HOOS, Harris Hip Score, SF-36)
- Pain score documentation (NRS ≥7 or VAS ≥70mm)
- BMI <40 (most plans); BMI 40-50 requires bariatric consultation note
- No active infection, malignancy, or severe comorbidities

**Reimbursement:** Commercial rates typically 120-180% of Medicare. eviCore, Carelon, or MCG criteria commonly used.

**Known Payer Policies:**
| Payer | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Aetna | Prior Auth Required | Clinical Policy Bulletin; eviCore criteria; 3-month conservative therapy |
| UnitedHealthcare | Prior Auth Required | Optum criteria; functional assessment required |
| BCBS | Prior Auth Required | Medical Policy; radiographic OA required; conservative therapy documentation |
| Cigna | Prior Auth Required | eviCore criteria; BMI <40 preferred |

## Documentation

### Clinical Documentation
- ✓ Office notes documenting hip OA/AVN diagnosis and symptom duration
- ✓ Pain score documentation at multiple visits
- ✓ Functional assessment (HOOS or Harris Hip Score)
- ✓ BMI and weight history

### Imaging
- ✓ Weight-bearing AP pelvis and lateral hip X-rays
- ✓ MRI if AVN or labral pathology suspected
- ✓ CT scan if complex anatomy or revision planning

### Conservative Therapy
- ✓ Physical therapy records (≥6 weeks)
- ✓ Medication trial documentation (NSAIDs, acetaminophen)
- ✓ Intraarticular injection records
- ✓ Assistive device trial if applicable

### Pre-operative Clearance
- ✓ Medical clearance from PCP or internist
- ✓ Cardiac risk assessment if indicated
- ✓ HbA1c <8% for diabetic patients
- ✓ BMI optimization plan if BMI >35

## Submission

1. Obtain weight-bearing AP pelvis and lateral hip X-rays with radiologist report.
2. Document ≥3 months conservative therapy with specific modalities and duration.
3. Complete functional assessment (HOOS or Harris Hip Score) and document pain scores.
4. Obtain pre-operative medical clearance and optimize modifiable risk factors.
5. Submit prior authorization request with CPT 27130 and primary ICD-10.
6. Include all supporting documentation: imaging reports, PT records, office notes.
7. If denied, request peer-to-peer review with the plan's medical director within 72 hours.

## Denial Reasons

- ⚠ Insufficient conservative therapy documentation (most common denial reason)
- ⚠ Inadequate radiographic evidence of hip OA severity
- ⚠ BMI >40 without documented weight loss program or bariatric consultation
- ⚠ Missing functional assessment scores (HOOS/Harris Hip Score not documented)
- ⚠ Uncontrolled diabetes (HbA1c >8%) without optimization plan
- ⚠ Active infection not addressed
- ⚠ Incomplete pre-operative clearance documentation
